# World time reference

The world clock, the day-night cycle and phase assets, the lighting that follows them, and the time-of-day requirement. For how to use it, see [World time](../modules/world-time.md).

## VtWorldClock

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → World Time → VtWorldClock**.

The scene's game clock. Place one per scene and assign a `VtDayNightDefinition`. It advances the time of day, counts days, raises `OnPhaseChanged` and `OnNewDay`, and applies the active phase's modifiers to every matching unit under the source id `ModifierSourceId`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Definition (`definition`) | [VtDayNightDefinition](#vtdaynightdefinition) | None | Day length and phases. Required. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtWorldClock Instance { get; }` | The scene's clock, or null when none is placed. |
| `static VtDayPhaseDefinition ActivePhase { get; }` | The phase of the scene clock, or null without a clock. |
| `VtDayNightDefinition Definition { get; }` | Day length and phases. |
| `VtWorldClockScheduler Scheduler { get; }` | The underlying clock, for reading and for headless hosts. |
| `int Day { get; }` | Day counter, starting at 1. |
| `float TimeOfDay { get; }` | Time of day from 0 (midnight) up to 1. |
| `float Hours { get; }` | Time of day in hours, 0 to 24. |
| `float TimeScale { get; }` | Speed multiplier. 1 = normal, 0 = stopped. |
| `bool Paused { get; }` | True while the clock is paused. |
| `VtDayPhaseDefinition CurrentPhase { get; }` | The active phase, or null when the definition has none. |
| `static event Action<VtDayPhaseDefinition, VtDayPhaseDefinition> OnPhaseChanged` | Fires when the scene clock's phase changes. Args: (previous, current). |
| `static event Action<int> OnNewDay` | Fires when the scene clock starts a new day, with the new day number. |
| `static event Action<VtWorldClock> OnClockAdjusted` | Fires on the authority after the scene clock was changed by hand through `SetTime`, `AdvanceHours`, `SetTimeScale` or `SetPaused`. Networking sends `CaptureState` to clients here. Normal ticking and `ApplyFromNet` do not raise it. |
| `const string ModifierSourceId` | Source id the active phase's modifiers are registered under on each unit. |
| `static bool IsAnyPhaseActive(VtDayPhaseDefinition[] phases)` | True when `phases` is empty, when the scene has no clock, or when the scene clock's phase is in the list. |
| `void Initialize()` | Build the clock from the definition. Idempotent. |
| `void SetDefinition(VtDayNightDefinition value)` | Swap the day-night definition. Restarts the clock on day 1 at the new definition's start time. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the clock by `deltaTime` real seconds. |
| `bool SetTime(int day, float timeOfDay)` | Jump to `timeOfDay` on `day`. Authority only; returns false on a client. |
| `bool SetTimeOfDay(float timeOfDay)` | Jump to `timeOfDay` on the current day. Authority only. |
| `bool AdvanceHours(float hours)` | Move forward by `hours` game hours, raising every phase and day change on the way. Use it for sleeping or waiting. Authority only. |
| `bool SetTimeScale(float scale)` | Set the speed multiplier. Authority only. |
| `bool SetPaused(bool paused)` | Pause or resume the clock. Authority only. |
| `VtWorldClockState CaptureState()` | Snapshot to send to clients or store in a save. |
| `void ApplyFromNet(VtWorldClockState state)` | Adopt the authority's snapshot on a client, and restore a save. |
| `void RefreshModifiers(VtUnit unit)` | Apply or remove the active phase's modifiers on `unit`. The clock does this on every phase change and whenever a unit is seeded; call it after changing a unit's tags or faction mid-phase. |

## VtDayNightLighting

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → World Time → VtDayNightLighting**.

Moves and tints the sun, and optionally the ambient light and fog, from the scene's `VtWorldClock` using a `VtDayNightLook`. Presentation only: it never changes gameplay, so every client runs it on its own. Swap the look asset to restyle a scene without touching the clock.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sun (`sun`) | `Light` | None | Directional light used as the sun. Required. |
| Look (`look`) | [VtDayNightLook](#vtdaynightlook) | None | Colors, brightness and sun path over the day. Required. |
| Rotate Sun (`rotateSun`) | `bool` | On | Rotate the sun along the look's path. Off keeps the light's own rotation. |
| Drive Ambient (`driveAmbient`) | `bool` | On | Set the scene's ambient light color. Needs Environment Lighting Source set to Color. |
| Drive Fog (`driveFog`) | `bool` | Off | Set the scene's fog color. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `Light Sun { get; set; }` | Directional light used as the sun. |
| `VtDayNightLook Look { get; set; }` | Colors, brightness and sun path over the day. |
| `void Apply(float timeOfDay)` | Show the look at `timeOfDay` right away, for previews and scenes without a clock. |

## VtDayNightDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → World Time → Day Night Cycle**.

The length of a game day and the phases it is split into. Assign it to the scene's `VtWorldClock`. Phases may be listed in any order; each one lasts until the next phase's start time, and the last phase of the day runs through midnight into the first.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Day Length Seconds (`dayLengthSeconds`) | `float` | 1200 | ≥ 1 | Real seconds one full game day takes at time scale 1. 1200 = a 20-minute day. |
| Start Time (`startTime`) | `float` | 0.3 | 0 to 1 | Time of day a new game starts at. 0 = midnight, 0.25 = 6:00, 0.5 = noon. |
| Phases (`phases`) | [VtDayPhaseDefinition](#vtdayphasedefinition)[] | Empty |  | The phases of the day, such as Dawn, Day, Dusk and Night. |

## VtDayPhaseDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → World Time → Day Phase**.

One part of the day, such as Dawn, Day, Dusk or Night. A phase starts at `startTime` and lasts until the next phase of its `VtDayNightDefinition` begins. Gameplay refers to phases by asset: spawners list the phases they are active in, quests and dialogue gate on them through `VtTimeOfDayRequirement`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | Name shown in the UI, or a localization key. |
| Start Time (`startTime`) | `float` | 0 | 0 to 1 | Where the phase starts in the day. 0 = midnight, 0.25 = 6:00, 0.5 = noon, 0.75 = 18:00. |
| Modifiers (`modifiers`) | [VtItemModifier](units.md#vtitemmodifier)[] | Empty |  | Stat changes every matching unit has while this phase is active. |
| Affected Tags (`affectedTags`) | [VtUnitTagDefinition](units.md#vtunittagdefinition)[] | Empty |  | Only units with at least one of these tags get the modifiers. Empty = no tag filter. |
| Affected Factions (`affectedFactions`) | [VtFaction](#vtfaction)[] | Empty |  | Only units of these factions get the modifiers. Empty = no faction filter. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool Affects(VtUnit unit)` | True when this phase's `modifiers` apply to `unit`. A unit must pass both the tag and the faction filter; an empty filter passes everyone. |

## VtDayNightLook

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → World Time → Day Night Look**.

How the scene looks over one day: sun color and brightness, ambient light and fog color, all sampled by time of day from 0 (midnight) to 1. Read by `VtDayNightLighting`. A new asset starts with a plain warm-day, blue-night look.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sun Color (`sunColor`) | `Gradient` | Gradient |  | Sun color over the day. |
| Sun Intensity (`sunIntensity`) | `AnimationCurve` | Curve |  | Sun intensity over the day. The time runs along X from 0 to 1. |
| Ambient Color (`ambientColor`) | `Gradient` | Gradient |  | Ambient light over the day. Needs Environment Lighting Source set to Color. |
| Fog Color (`fogColor`) | `Gradient` | Gradient |  | Fog color over the day. Used when the lighting component drives fog. |
| Sun Yaw (`sunYaw`) | `float` | -30 | -180 to 180 | Compass direction the sun travels along, in degrees. |
| Noon Elevation (`noonElevation`) | `float` | 70 | 0 to 90 | Highest sun angle above the horizon at noon, in degrees. 90 = straight down. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `Quaternion SunRotation(float timeOfDay)` | Sun rotation at `timeOfDay`: rising at 6:00, highest at noon, setting at 18:00, below the horizon at night. |

## VtTimeOfDayRequirement

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Quests → Requirements → Time Of Day**. Inherits [VtQuestRequirement](quests.md#vtquestrequirement).

Quest and dialogue requirement: the scene clock is in one of `phases` and has reached `minimumDay`. Use it for "only offered at night" quests or answers a guard only gives after dark. Without a `VtWorldClock` in the scene it never passes.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phases (`phases`) | [VtDayPhaseDefinition](#vtdayphasedefinition)[] | Empty |  | The clock must be in one of these phases. Empty = any phase. |
| Minimum Day (`minimumDay`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | The clock must have reached at least this day. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `override bool IsMet(VtUnit holder)` | True when the scene clock has reached `minimumDay` and is in one of `phases`. False without a `VtWorldClock` in the scene. |

## VtWorldClockState

Serializable struct.

Everything needed to reproduce a `VtWorldClock` on another machine or after a load. Send it from the authority to clients, and store it in saves.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day (`day`) | `int` | 0 | Day counter, starting at 1. |
| Time Of Day (`timeOfDay`) | `float` | 0 | Time of day from 0 (midnight) up to 1. |
| Time Scale (`timeScale`) | `float` | 0 | Speed multiplier. 1 = normal, 0 = stopped. |
| Paused (`paused`) | `bool` | Off | True while the clock is paused. |

## Enums

### VtFaction

Team or allegiance of a `VtUnit`. Units of different factions fight each other unless either is Neutral; AI targeting, splash damage and projectiles all respect it.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Neutral` | Unaffiliated or ambient — not targeted, not hostile. |
| `Player` | The local player and their summons / pets. |
| `Enemy` | Scripted hostile units (waves, bosses). |
| `Wildlife` | Passive NPCs (deer, rabbits) — flee when attacked, don't aggro. |
